How this site is built

The same workflow real teams use, run in the open. You can follow every step on GitHub.

  1. Main sets the rules

    The main model built the skeleton, shared styles and the module template, then committed them to main.

  2. Contributor branches off

    git switch -c module/06-branching. Work happens away from main, so nothing live can break.

  3. Commit and push

    Small commits, then git push -u origin <branch>. The live site does not change yet.

  4. Open a pull request

    The contributor asks to merge. The main model reviews the diff and asks for changes if needed.

  5. Merge into main

    After approval, the branch is merged. GitHub Pages rebuilds and the module goes live.

Roadmap

Solid cards are merged into main. Dashed cards are still being built on their branch.
